bull_bear.body:
- States a deliberate 'balanced approach' where EPC generates immediate cash flows and RESCO builds long-term annuity value, explicitly described as creating 'a stable, high-ROCE model.'
- Converted to a Public Limited company in 2024 (authorised capital ₹25 Cr) and listed on BSE in 2026, providing a public-market capital base to fund RESCO asset build-out via subsidiaries GRE Green Energy Private Limited and GRE Green Assets.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Established in 2008, GRE Renew Enertech is a renewable energy company offering turnkey solar EPC (design, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, O&M) for industrial, commercial and government customers, plus energy-efficient LED lighting products, and is ISO 9001:2015 certified with 18+ years of operations.
- Runs a dual business model - EPC (CAPEX) for execution-based, high-margin lump-sum revenue and asset-light operations, and RESCO (OPEX) where GRE owns the asset and earns 25-year predictable annuity cash flows - explicitly framed as 'a stable, high-ROCE model.'
- Client base spans government/defence (Rashtrapati Bhawan rooftop project, CRPF, BSF, CISF) and industrial/commercial names (Golf Ceramics, Pragna Pharma, Pragna Dyechem, Uma Kraft Paper, Reliance Jio, Futaba Industrial), reflecting a diversified customer mix across captive and non-captive projects.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body: - [Corporate History] Originally incorporated in 1999 as GRE Electronics Pvt Ltd (CFL products); entered LED manufacturing and established wholly-owned US subsidiary D K USA Inc. in 2015; strategically pivoted to solar as its core focus in 2013-14; renamed GRE Renew Enertech in 2023 ahead of its 2024 conversion to Public Limited and 2026 BSE listing.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: GRE Renew Enertech positions itself as an 18+ year renewable-energy player combining asset-light solar EPC execution with a growing RESCO (owned-asset annuity) portfolio and a supporting LED lighting manufacturing business, aiming for a 'balanced, high-ROCE' model as it expands beyond its Gujarat base.
